cohort: 206 women admitted to the gynecology ward with symptoms of mass per vagina at a tertiary care hospital and medical college in Lucknow, India, between January 2019 and January 2021.
finding: Multiparity, prolonged and difficult deliveries, delivery by untrained personnel, mismanaged third stage of labor, and postmenopausal status were associated with uterovaginal prolapse.
mod_finding: Deliveries by untrained personnel and mismanaged third stage of labor were associated with uterovaginal prolapse.
